title: Terminal VM sizing and Storybook live runtime
answers: How do I run the real terminal runtime in Storybook?
Where do installed terminal tools live in the guest?
body:
- Guest memory is `memory_size: 512 * 1024 * 1024` in `terminalRuntime.ts`; installed tools go on a separate 256m tmpfs at `/opt/posthog-packages` mounted in the boot script, so they vanish when the terminal stops. Comments should not hard-code the memory size (see `terminalCommands.ts`).
- Storybook stories mock `TerminalRuntime.prototype.start` in `TerminalScene.stories.tsx` so snapshots don't depend on firmware/boot. A story that needs the real VM sets `parameters: { liveRuntime: true }` and `tags: ['!test']` (see `LiveRuntime`) so it is skipped by visual tests.
